resale_co.name: Resale Certificate
resale_co.issued_by: Department of Code Enforcement, Borough of Highland Park
resale_co.valid_for: Temporary Resale Certificate: up to 3 months (extension possible)
requirements: All open building permits must be closed before closing
Smoke/CO certificate from the Middlesex County Fire Marshal must be submitted to Code Enforcement before the final Resale Certificate is issued
Final water meter reading scheduled and done with the Tax/Water Department before closing
A Temporary Resale Certificate is possible when the home is not habitable at closing or the buyer accepts existing violations; the buyer then schedules the resale inspection

fees.label: Resale Application
fees.quote: Both the Resale Application ($75) and Temporary Resale Application ($50) must be submitted and paid in full.

fees.label: Temporary Resale Application (only when a Temporary Resale Certificate is used; in addition to the Resale Application)
fees.quote: Both the Resale Application ($75) and Temporary Resale Application ($50) must be submitted and paid in full.

resale_co.how_to_apply: The owner or realtor submits the Resale Application (linked on the Borough Code Enforcement / Property Maintenance page) to the Department of Code Enforcement, 221 South 5th Avenue, Highland Park. Pay by check, cash (exact change) or money order payable to BOROUGH OF HIGHLAND PARK; no credit cards or online payment. Inspections are at the exact time the office gives; an adult 18 or older must be present to give access.

evidence.quote: The owner of any residential building or dwelling unit, whether single-family or multi-family, must obtain a Resale Certificate before the change/transfer in ownership.
Failure to apply for a resale certificate may result in a fine of up to $500.00 per day.
All open building permits must be closed prior to closing.
The final Resale Certificate will NOT be issued until the Smoke/CO Certificate has been received and approved.
The Temporary Resale Certificate is valid for up to 3 months. An extension may be granted upon proof that corrective work is in progress.
All fees must be paid in full by check, cash (exact change), or money order. Credit cards and online payments are not accepted.

resale_co.notes: The live Borough site (hpboro.com) blocks automated access, so the Code Enforcement / Property Maintenance page was read from its Internet Archive copy captured June 7, 2026 (original URL: https://www.hpboro.com/departments/construction/housing-inspections-1167). The Resale Application PDF linked there could not be opened (not archived), so the resale inspection checklist and lead time are unknown; the application_url is the link as published. The inspector email is shown as csumano@hpboro.com but the link behind it points to csurmano@hpboro.com; the displayed address is recorded. The rental program (rental certificate, lead-based paint inspection $145, $50 re-inspection, $125 + $150 emergency inspection, rent control) is a rental requirement, not a resale fee.

fire_cert.notes: Highland Park is county enforced (DCA registry code C). The Borough page names the Middlesex County Office of the Fire Marshal as the inspecting agency and gives its general phone and email; the state directory (survey 1/16/2026) names Michael Gallagher as Fire Official with email mike.gallagher@co.middlesex.nj.us. The Borough page gives the county ZIP as 08879 while the state directory gives 08872. No county fee or lead time was found. The Highland Park Fire Department (volunteer) is the suppression company, not the inspecting agency.
